mapper.select: SELECT r.patient_id AS patientId, p.patient_no AS patientNo, p.name AS name, r.relation_type AS relationType, r.is_default AS isDefault FROM user_patient_relation r INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = r.patient_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.is_default DESC, r.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_patient_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
